description: E-Ladepunkte Chemnitz (WMS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stadtverwaltung Chemnitz. Visualisation of the locations (and factual data) of the recharging points of e-mobility (‘electric refuelling stations’) in the context of alternative mobility. Coverage: Stadtverwaltung Chemnitz. The portal shows the English title as "E-charging points Chemnitz (WMS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stadtverwaltung Chemnitz. Its keywords include Ladepunkte, Chemnitz, Elektromobilität, Elektroladesäulen, E-Tankstellen, infoMapAccessService. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2026-08-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
